name: Lanzahíta (Spain)
description: Quartered red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lanzahíta (a lance with a pennon of Castile and León on white).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially by decree of 1 July 1994 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 150 of 4 August 1994); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, quartered red and white, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Lanzahíta arms — lance with pennon on white
